d:
Times Music presents Wakhra Swag , the Punjabi song that is the ultimate party anthem. Featuring Badshah, Navv Inder & Aman Hundal, this Punjabi dance song delivers the perfect mix of catchy hooks and that pure desi swag you just can't get enough of. With its infectious energy and power-packed Punjabi rap, Wakhra Swag is the ultimate Punjabi party song that redefines what Punjabi music sounds like.
